# Tool loans — Test case specification

Source PRD: [Tool loans](../prds/LIB-1-loans.md) · Owner: QA

### TC-01 — A member borrows a free tool

- **Covers:** FR-1.1

A member taps "Borrow" on a free drill and sees a return date seven days ahead.

### TC-02 — A borrowed tool cannot be borrowed again

- **Covers:** FR-1.2

A second member taps "Borrow" on the same drill and is told to ask at the desk.

### TC-03 — The desk closes a loan

- **Covers:** FR-2.1

The desk scans the drill back; the loan closes and the member gets a receipt.
